sources.title: EfficientUNet: An efficient solution for breast tumour segmentation in ...
sources.snippet: The main work of this paper is to propose an effective neu-ral network model, EfficientUNet, for tumour segmentation in breast ultrasound images. The overall architecture of the model follows the U-Net design pattern through a gradual enhance-ment method, combining ResNet18 [16], a channel attention mechanism and deep supervision technology.
